verdict.rationale: Riveter's scrape turns a URL into parseable text, and the marketing site says it 'reads PDFs and images' as inputs to a workflow. Nothing documents automatic captions or alt-text descriptions for images on a scraped page that a text-only model could consume. Reading images during enrichment is an adjacent capability, not the captioning described in the story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get automatic captions for images on a page so a text-only model can reason about visual content
